hints: Split the ester name into two parts, the alcohol part comes first and the acid part comes second.
The methanoate part tells you the acid must have just one carbon, which is methanoic acid, $\text{HCO}_2\text{H}$.
The propyl part tells you the alcohol must have three carbons, so pair that 3-carbon alcohol with the 1-carbon acid to find the match.
walkthrough:
**Recall how esters are made**

Esters are made by esterification of a carboxylic acid with an alcohol in the presence of concentrated sulfuric acid catalyst.

$$\text{carboxylic acid} + \text{alcohol} \rightleftharpoons \text{ester} + \text{water}$$

**Decode the ester name**

The second word tells you the acid. Methanoate means methanoic acid, $\text{HCO}_2\text{H}$. The first word tells you the alcohol. Propyl means propanol, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{OH}$.

$$\text{propyl methanoate} = \text{HCO}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_3$$

**Write the matching reaction**

Put that acid and that alcohol together to make the ester.

$$\text{HCO}_2\text{H} + \text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{OH} \rightleftharpoons \text{HCO}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_3 + \text{H}_2\text{O}$$

**Pick the mixture**

Only the mixture of propan-1-ol and methanoic acid gives propyl methanoate.

options.A: Incorrect. Propanoic acid, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CO}_2\text{H}$, with methanol, $\text{CH}_3\text{OH}$, gives methyl propanoate, not propyl methanoate. The acid and alcohol parts are swapped in size.
options.B: Incorrect. Methanoic acid is correct for a methanoate, but butan-1-ol, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{OH}$, has four carbons and would give butyl methanoate. This is the trap of miscounting the alcohol chain.
options.C: Correct. Methanoic acid, $\text{HCO}_2\text{H}$, provides the methanoate part and propan-1-ol, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{OH}$, provides the propyl part to form propyl methanoate plus water.
options.D: Incorrect. Butanoic acid, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CO}_2\text{H}$, with methanol gives methyl butanoate. Students who confuse which end of the name is acid and which is alcohol may pick this.
